correctness.rationale: Centering primal and two memory-table errors gives the two explicit 3×3 random update matrices T1,T2. The exact 6×6 symmetric covariance lift L=p T1⊗sym T1+(1−p)T2⊗sym T2 has det(I−L)=−4α F_{p(1−p)}(α), verified by independent symbolic algebra. At α=0, characteristic polynomial λ(λ−1)(λ−p)²(λ−q)² with simple unit root departing at slope −4; cone positivity prevents an earlier unit-radius crossing without an eigenvalue +1. Unique positive root F=0 is exact robust mean-square iff boundary, including deterministic-start witness by rank-one decomposition. dF/du<0 makes p=1/2 unique maximizer α*=1/√3; α*~min(p,1−p). Signed mean obeys factor 1−2α and can contract beyond mean-square stability. Independent roots at p=.1,.25,.4,.5 and eigenvalue crossings corroborate.
